title: Page 9
content_zh:
一早，天刚亮起，便见龙焱拎着枣儿惯用的箩筐，边摘着藤上的豆荚，一边喃喃报告他晚些将做的事。
“昨午醇亲王差人送来信箴，说李进答应今晚到他府里作客，所以我一过午，就得到王爷府准备。”
突然一阵寒风吹扬了龙焱身上的衣角，他揽揽身上的皮裘，惦着不知身在何方的枣儿，有没有吃饱，有没有穿暖。
“你这个傻丫头，竟把我拨给你的银两都留下了，也不想想你一个姑娘家还带着你爹，两人四只手能以什么为生……”他仰头望着天上浮云，忍不住幽幽叹息。
他双手合十祈求，说出他唯一的心愿——
“天上的神明啊，请您务必要保佑她安全无虞。在找回她之前，千万千万别让她出了什么岔子。”
这是枣儿离开后第十日，度日如年的十日。
当晚，醇亲王府——
“下官见过醇王爷。”李进一拜。
“免礼。”长得富富泰泰、笑口常开的醇亲王说道：“坐。”
李进起身落坐。“不知醇王爷突然请下官过来，有何吩咐？”
“没什么，只是想跟你聊聊送礼的事，你也知道咱们普宁公主即将出嫁……”醇亲王手一挥，旁边仆佣立刻送上酒菜。
为了今晚这场宴席，龙焱可卯足了劲准备。一方面是答谢嗜吃的醇亲王的帮忙，一方面是想用吃，松懈李进心房。
葱烤鲫鱼、油焖笋、红烧黄鱼、干菜焖肉；青脆只留最嫩处的清炒豌豆，再一盅炖得细致的黄焖鱼翅。
几杯酒水下肚，醇亲王托辞暂离，就在这时候，龙焱上场。
“草民龙焱见过李大人。”
正挟着焖肉就嘴的李进手倏停，一瞟桌上佳肴，再一望立在跟前的龙焱，他一下全明白了。原来醇亲王只是诱他现身的幌子，酒宴真正的东道主是眼前人。好个龙焱！他完全没料到会是他。
李进咽下筷中菜，说：“我才说醇亲王家的厨子手艺何时变得这般好，原来是龙当家亲自掌勺。”
“草民冒犯，还望李大人见谅，但草民确实是想不出其它法子联络长年在宫中的您，才会商请醇王爷帮忙。”
“找我什么事？”

龙焱倏地抬头，一双黑眸犹如黑夜明星，熠熠发亮。“草民斗胆请问李大人，草民的妻子石枣儿呢？李大人将她带到哪儿去了？”[热A书$吧&独@家*制#作]
“你哪只眼睛看见我带走石枣儿？”李进挑眉，还想装蒜。
“草民全都知道了。”龙焱拿出石老庐的亲笔信，一字一句诵出信中所写，还读不到一半，随即被李进抢走。
李进眼一瞄读完，表情尴尬。可恶！竟忘了提防那个糟老头。
“没错，人的确是我带走，怎么样？”
龙焱往前跨了一大步。“告诉我她在哪里。”
“办不到。”李进不由分说。“带走她是公主的命令，我不可能违抗公主命令。”
“为什么？”龙焱惊讶喊道：“公主明明已经跟其它人订亲了。”
“因为你得罪了她。”李进摇头。“我劝过你，你明知道公主脾气娇蛮，绝不可能坐视被人欺负，你还一而再拒绝她。”
“难道您认为我应该不分青红皂白答应跟公主成亲、任她耍弄？”
李进一瞪。“公主是当今皇上的掌上明珠，你呢？你是什么东西？”
响应普宁公主时，龙焱承认他确实太过莽撞，如果早知道皇上会另将公主许配给别人，他开头就该跟她虚与委蛇，但谁料得到“早知道”。他当时一心就想绝不辜负枣儿一番情意，才会拗着脾气坚持到底。
“就算我有错，枣儿也是无辜的，她一个姑娘家才多大，她爹身体又不好，您就那么忍心见她离乡背井？”
“我已经破例帮过她忙了。”李进告诉龙焱那一夜的约定。一般人可能难以想像，对李进这种一辈子恪守王命的人来说，要她违抗主子的命令，是多难的一件事。
龙焱心起了希望，既然李进破例过一次，应该不难求到第二次。
龙焱突然下跪，朝李进深深磕头。“李大人，我不是要求您为我违背公主的命令，但请您想想枣儿，她是无辜的，触怒公主的人是我，要罚也该罚我，不该由她代为受过。”
李进一挥手打断他。“说来说去，你就是要我告诉你石枣儿的去处？”
龙焱再磕头。“求李大人成全。”
求他这种事！李进用力扒头。跟要他违背公主命令有什么两样？这两个家伙真是吃了熊心豹子胆，竟一而再跟他提这种要求！
李进瞪着脚边的龙焱，他知道自己大可以甩袖走人，可脑子一想起枣儿那晚的表情，又犹豫起来了。

那丫头从头到尾没怪过他一句。那日送他们上船，他叮咛过船主在何处将他们放下后，他曾塞给她一迭银票，但她只是摇摇头，她爹也一样，表示他们不能收。
两个穷鬼偏这么有骨气。李进当时一气就走了，可当船一远离，他便知道自己后悔了。
李进望着眼前狼藉的杯盘，一个主意突然自他脑里升起。
“我给你一个考验，只要你通过这个考验，我就告诉你她在哪里。”
“我一定会通过！”龙焱说得坚定，双眼满是希望。
“话先别说得那么早。”李进一哼。“我的条件说简单也不简单，今后每十天你就来王爷府上料理一桌好菜，为期半年，只要你一次没来，这个约定就取消。”
这么久！龙焱皱紧眉头。“不能您现在就告诉我？我保证这半年之约绝不延误！”
李进一句话堵住他口。“公主的婚期定在半年后的初五。”
龙焱懂了，据报，与公主成亲的男子是山南东道节度使之子，换句话说，半年之后她即不在京城，那时就算接回枣儿，公主也天高地远，拿他俩没辙。
但这半年之约实带有另一涵义——李进要绊住龙焱，不让他有机会离城去找枣儿。他就怕公主又一时兴起微服出宫，结果龙焱却已提前找到石枣儿，又闹出一场风波。
“怎么样？”
龙焱紧闭眼深吸了口气，最后一咬牙，点头。
“我答应。”
时光荏苒，冬去春来，和李进所定的半年之约，再过十天，即告终结。
这半年里发生了很多事，庄里几个光棍纷纷娶了妻，二厨王二的媳妇也怀了身孕。落座在石家边的六房跨院，前日也告竣工。从那天开始，龙焱搬出“一条龙”，只领着一小撮扑役，独自守着跨院，还有外头的菜园。
先前枣儿留下的头簪衣裳，他件件亲手将它们收进他房里，至于地窖的腌菜自他习惯对它们喃喃说话后，也开始变得乖巧听话，不再动辄腐坏。
“一条龙”来了几个新跑堂，也走了些人，很多东西不知不觉变了，就连他的发鬓，也因为入骨的思念，隐约泛出了白发。可有些东西还是一样，他身旁龙夫人那个位置，始终空着，只为一个女人保留。
他依然守着他的承诺，不曾改变。
而他也知道，枣儿定也会处在某个他不知道的地方，一样，深深地喜欢着他。
过午，“一条龙”饭庄——

“龙爷。”账房敲了门后匆匆进来。“刚才外边有个小乞儿，突然拿来这信，指名给您。”
龙焱放下书，接过信箴。一见，他倏地站起。
账房吓了一跳。“怎么了？上头写些什么？”
“你拿去自个儿看。”
龙焱匆匆将信纸塞进账房手里，账房还来不及看，他人早冲了出去。
content_en:
Early in the morning, as soon as the sky dawned, Long Yan was seen carrying the basket that Zaoer usually used, picking pods from the vines, and murmuring reports on what he would do later.
"Prince Chun sent a letter yesterday afternoon, saying that Li Jin promised to be a guest at his residence tonight, so I went to the prince's residence to prepare as soon as noon."
Suddenly a gust of cold wind blew up the corners of Long Yan's clothes. He hugged the furs on his body and wondered whether Zao'er, who didn't know where he was, had enough to eat and whether he was wearing warm clothes.
"You silly girl, you actually kept all the money I allocated to you. You don't even think about how you, a girl, and your father, can make a living with four hands..." He looked up at the floating clouds in the sky and couldn't help but sigh.
He clasped his hands in prayer and expressed his only wish——
"God in the sky, please keep her safe. Before you find her, don't let anything go wrong with her."
This is the tenth day after Zaoer left, and the tenth day is like a year.
That night, Prince Chun’s Mansion——
"I have met Prince Chun." Li Jin bowed.
"No courtesy." Prince Chun, who looked prosperous and always smiled, said, "Sit down."
Li Jin stood up and sat down. "I wonder if Prince Chun suddenly invited his subordinates to come over. What are your instructions?"
"Nothing, I just want to talk to you about giving gifts. You also know that our Princess Puning is about to get married..." Prince Chun waved his hand, and the servants next to him immediately brought food and wine.
For tonight's banquet, Long Yanke worked hard to prepare. On the one hand, it was to thank Prince Chun who was fond of food for his help, and on the other hand, he wanted to use food to relax Li Jin's heart.
Grilled crucian carp with green onion, braised bamboo shoots in oil, braised yellow croaker, braised pork with dried vegetables; crispy fried peas with only the tenderest part left, and a cup of braised shark fin that is carefully stewed.
After a few glasses of wine, Prince Chun excused himself to leave temporarily. At this moment, Long Yan came on stage.
"Caomin Long Yan has met Mr. Li."
Li Jin, who was eating the stewed meat, suddenly stopped, glanced at the food on the table, and then at Long Yan standing in front of him, and he understood everything at once. It turns out that Prince Chun is just a cover to lure him to show up, and the real host of the banquet is the person in front of him. What a great Long Yan! He didn't expect it to be him at all.
Li Jin swallowed the food with his chopsticks and said, "I just said when did the chefs in Prince Chun's family become so good? It turns out that it was Master Long himself who was in charge."
"I hope that Mr. Li will forgive me for the offence. However, the common people really couldn't think of any other way to contact you who has been in the palace for many years, so they asked Prince Chun for help."
"What do you want from me?"
Long Yan raised his head suddenly, his black eyes shining like stars in the night. "Cao Min dares to ask Mr. Li, where is Cao Min's wife Shi Zao'er? Where did Mr. Li take her?" [Hot A Book $ Bar & Du @ Home * Production #]
"Which of your eyes saw me taking Shi Zao'er away?" Li Jin raised his eyebrows, still trying to show off.
"All the common people know it." Long Yan took out Shi Laolu's autographed letter and read out what was written in the letter word for word. He didn't read half of it before he was snatched away by Li Jin.
Li Jin glanced at it and finished reading it, his expression awkward. hateful! I forgot to watch out for that bad old man.
"Yes, I did take the person away, how about it?"
Long Yan took a big step forward. "Tell me where she is."
"It can't be done." Li Jin couldn't help but say. "It is the princess's order to take her away. There is no way I can disobey the princess's order."
"Why?" Long Yan shouted in surprise: "The princess is obviously engaged to someone else."
"Because you offended her." Li Jin shook his head. "I have advised you. You know that the princess has a delicate temper and will never sit back and watch being bullied, yet you still reject her again and again."
"Do you think I should agree to marry the princess indiscriminately and let her play with her?"
Li Jin stared. "The princess is the apple of the eye of the current emperor, what about you? Who are you?"
When responding to Princess Puning, Long Yan admitted that he was indeed too reckless. If he had known that the emperor would betroth the princess to someone else, he should have followed her at the beginning.She was conceited and resigned, but who would have expected that she would "know it sooner". At that time, he only wanted to live up to Zaoer's affection, so he could hold on to his temper and persevere to the end.
"Even if I am wrong, Zao'er is innocent. She is only a young girl, and her father is not in good health. How can you bear to see her leave her hometown?"
"I have already made an exception to help her." Li Jin told Long Yan about the agreement that night. It may be difficult for ordinary people to imagine how difficult it is for Li Jin, a person who has always adhered to the king's orders, to disobey her master's orders.
Long Yan began to hope that since Li Jin had made an exception once, it should not be difficult to get him a second time.
Long Yan suddenly knelt down and kowtowed deeply to Li Jin. "Master Li, I'm not asking you to disobey the princess's order for me, but please think about Zao'er. She is innocent. I am the one who offended the princess. If you want to punish me, I should be punished. She should not have to suffer it on her behalf."
Li Jin interrupted him with a wave of his hand. "After all, you just want me to tell you where Shi Zao'er is?"
Long Yan kowtowed again. "Please, Mr. Li, please grant me your permission."
Ask him for such a thing! Li Jin scratched his head hard. What's the difference between asking him to disobey the princess's orders? These two guys were so brave that they made such requests to him again and again!
Li Jin stared at Long Yan at his feet. He knew he could just throw up his sleeves and leave, but when he remembered Zao'er's expression that night, he hesitated again.
The girl never blamed him from the beginning to the end. That day when he sent them to the boat, he gave her a wad of banknotes after instructing the captain where to drop them off, but she just shook her head, and her father did the same, saying they couldn't accept it.
These two poor guys are so brave. Li Jin left in anger, but as soon as the ship moved away, he knew he regretted it.
Li Jin looked at the messy cups and plates in front of him, and an idea suddenly came to his mind.
"I will give you a test. As long as you pass this test, I will tell you where she is."
"I will definitely pass!" Long Yan said firmly, his eyes full of hope.
"Don't say it so early." Li Jin snorted. "My conditions are not simple at all. From now on, you will come to the prince's house to prepare a table of delicious food every ten days for half a year. If you fail to come even once, this agreement will be cancelled."
So long! Long Yan frowned. "Can't you tell me now? I promise that this half-year appointment will not be delayed!"
Li Jin blocked his mouth with one sentence. "The princess's wedding is scheduled for the fifth day of the lunar month in half a year."
Long Yan understood. It was reported that the man who married the princess was the son of the Jiedushi of Shannan Province. In other words, she would not be in the capital in half a year. Even if she took Zaoer back by then, the princess would be far away and there would be nothing to do with them.
But the six-month agreement actually had another meaning - Li Jin wanted to hinder Long Yan and prevent him from leaving the city to find Zao'er. He was afraid that the princess would leave the palace incognito again on a whim, but Long Yan had found Shi Zaoer in advance and caused another disturbance.
"How's it going?"
Long Yan closed his eyes tightly and took a deep breath, gritted his teeth for the last time, and nodded.
"I promise."
Time flies, winter turns to spring, and the six-month appointment with Li Jin will come to an end in ten days.
A lot of things happened in the past six months. Several bachelors in the village got married one after another, and the wife of the second chef Wang Er was also pregnant. The six-bedroom courtyard located next to Shi's house was also completed the day before yesterday. From that day on, Long Yan moved out of "One Dragon" and led only a small group of soldiers to guard the courtyard and the vegetable garden outside.
He personally took the hairpins and clothes that Zao'er had left behind and put them into his room one by one. As for the pickles in the cellar, since he got used to whispering to them, they began to become obedient and no longer rotten easily.
Several new waiters came to "Yilong", and some people left. Many things changed unknowingly. Even his hair on the temples was vaguely white because of the longing that penetrated his bones. But some things are still the same. The position of Mrs. Long next to him is always empty, just for one person.Women reserved.
He still kept his promise and never changed.
And he also knew that Zaoer would definitely be somewhere he didn't know, and she would also like him deeply.
After noon, the "one-stop" restaurant——
"Master Long." The accountant knocked on the door and hurried in. "There was a little beggar outside just now. He suddenly brought this letter and named it to you."
Long Yan put down the book and took the letter. When he saw it, he stood up quickly.
The cashier was startled. "What's wrong? What's written on it?"
"Take it and see for yourself."
Long Yan hurriedly put the letter into the accountant's hand. Before the accountant could read it, the others rushed out.
